lead: Subhas Chandra Bose was a politician, born on 23 January 1897 in Cuttack.
He died on 18 August 1945 in Taihoku at the age of 48.
He is associated with work such as The Indian Struggle and has held the office of President of the Indian National Congress and Mayor of Kolkata.
Below you will find a verified overview of Subhas Chandra Bose: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Subhas Chandra Bose — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Subhas Chandra Bose was born on 23 January 1897 in Cuttack, and holds citizenship of British Raj.
Public records name his father, Janakinath Bose and his mother, Prabhabati Bose. He is a sibling of Sarat Chandra Bose, Sunil Chandra Bose and Suresh Chandra Bose.
His listed education includes University of Calcutta, Fitzwilliam College, Presidency University and Scottish Church College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi, Bangla and English.

sections.heading: Subhas Chandra Bose — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, revolutionary, writer, freedom fighter, autobiographer and resistance fighter as his occupations, including work with Indian Civil Service.
Among the credits most often linked to Subhas are The Indian Struggle.

He has held the following offices: President of the Indian National Congress (1938–1939), Mayor of Kolkata (1930–1931) and commander-in-chief (1943–1945). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.

paras: He was married to Emilie Schenkl (married 1937, until 1945).
